_notes: The game clock and its events, recorded by running UQM 0.8.0's own clock.c (InitGameClock, GameClockTick, MoveGameClockDays, AddEvent, processClockDayEvents) and gameev.c (AddInitialGameEvents, EventHandler) in the recording program tools/extract/golden/clock.c. Code only, no content. check_hyperspace_encounter is only counted (every race starts with no growth, so check_race_growth changes nothing).

Each scenario: its commands (new: a new game; day N: N days of GameClockTick; move N: MoveGameClockDays (N); hyper 0|1: the flagship out of or in hyperspace; rampdown: what slyhome.c does when told of the self-destruct code) and its steps: one after new and rampdown, one each day of day, one for the whole of move.

A step: [[year, month, day] after it, [[event, depth, year, month, day]...] each event EventHandler ran, in order, depth 0 for those clock.c ran (from the queue's head, or AddEvent's due at once) and more for one run at once from within another, with the date it ran on, check_hyperspace_encounter's calls, SLYLANDRO_MULTIPLIER after, [[event, year, month, day]...] the queue after]. Events are gameev.h's numbers (data/events.json).
